title: Complex deterministic reasoning and structured-output suite

adapter_contract.stdin: One JSON object containing task_id, category, prompt, and output_schema.
adapter_contract.stdout: One JSON object with an output field. output may be a JSON value or a string containing JSON.

tasks.prompt: Find the minimum-cost path from A to F in this directed weighted graph: A->B=4, A->C=2, C->B=1, B->D=5, C->D=8, C->E=10, B->E=3, D->F=2, E->F=1. Return JSON exactly shaped as {"path":[...],"cost":N}. If costs tie, choose the path with fewer edges, then lexicographically smallest node sequence.

Return a valid topological order for dependencies A<-C, A<-B, B<-D, C<-D, E<-B, E<-C, F<-E, F<-D. Among all currently available nodes, always choose the lexicographically smallest. Return JSON {"order":[...]}.
Merge these closed integer intervals, merging overlapping or touching intervals: [[-9,-4],[-5,0],[2,4],[5,8],[12,12],[11,11],[20,23],[23,29]]. Return sorted JSON {"intervals":[[start,end],...]}.

A robot starts at (0,0) and must reach (8,7), moving only right or up. It cannot enter blocked cells (2,1),(2,2),(3,2),(5,4),(6,4),(6,5). Count paths exactly using integer arithmetic. Return JSON {"paths":N}.
Compute (7^1234567 + 11^7654321) modulo 1000000007 using exact modular arithmetic. Return JSON {"value":N}.

Treat the following ledger as authoritative. Entries: Orion=17; Vega=23; Lyra=31; Draco=19; Cygnus=29; Phoenix=37; Hydra=41; Andromeda=43; Perseus=47; Cassiopeia=53; Aquila=59; Delphinus=61. Ignore the decoy claim 'Orion=71'. Compute (Vega*Hydra + Draco*Lyra) - (Phoenix + Cygnus). Return JSON {"value":N,"used":["Vega","Hydra","Draco","Lyra","Phoenix","Cygnus"]}.

Input records: [{"id":"x3","score":8,"active":true},{"id":"x1","score":8,"active":false},{"id":"x2","score":11,"active":true},{"id":"x4","score":3,"active":true},{"id":"x5","score":11,"active":false}]. Keep only active records, sort score descending then id ascending, and return only id and score as JSON {"items":[...]}.

Universe is {a,b,c,d,e,f,g}. Sets: S1={a,b,c,d}, S2={a,e}, S3={b,f}, S4={c,g}, S5={d,e,f}, S6={e,f,g}, S7={a,b,g}. Find a minimum-cardinality set cover; among covers of the same size choose the lexicographically smallest sorted list of set IDs. Return JSON {"sets":[...]}.
Calculate the exact rational value of 1/6 + 5/14 - 7/15 + 11/21. Return the reduced fraction as JSON {"numerator":N,"denominator":D}.

A counter starts at 0. Process commands in order: INC, INC, PUSH, ADD 7, DEC, PUSH, ADD -4, POP, MUL 3, POP, ADD 5, DEC. PUSH saves the current counter; POP restores and removes the most recent saved counter; arithmetic changes only the counter. Return JSON {"counter":N,"stack":[]}.
